# Shubham Dholakiya Portfolio

> Full-stack engineering, AI/ML student at CHARUSAT, building autonomous SaaS applications and intelligent systems.

## Core Navigation

- [Home](http://localhost:5173/): System summary, mission statement, personal parameters, and technical skills.
- [Projects](http://localhost:5173/projects): Live GitHub repository explorer with real-time API sync and search.
- [Contact](http://localhost:5173/contact): Secure socket communication transmission payload form.
- [Todo Board](http://localhost:5173/todo): Full-stack task management board with MongoDB persistence and JWT security.
